about.description: I'm a passionate software engineer with {{years}} years of experience building scalable applications. Currently enhancing HR platforms at TriNet, and previously contributed to critical infrastructure at Microsoft where I worked on BuildXL - a build engine used by major teams including Office and Windows.

section.title: About Me
section.lead: I specialize in full-stack development with expertise in Angular, Spring Boot, and enterprise-scale applications. My experience spans from building internal tools at Microsoft to developing customer-facing applications at Staples, and now enhancing HR platforms at TriNet.
section.description: I'm passionate about creating efficient, scalable solutions and thrive in collaborative environments where I can contribute to meaningful projects while continuously learning and growing. Recently, I've expanded my expertise by completing a certification in Generative AI with Large Language Models, deepening my knowledge of AI integration and cutting-edge technology. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies or enjoying a good cup of coffee!
section.footer: This portfolio was crafted with Angular 17 and a lot of coffee! ☕
